summary: Relief bounce on cooler PCE (2.4% vs 2.5% expected) after hawkish Fed shock. Triple witching $6.6T OPEX dominates intraday flow. Rotation regime confirmed — airlines and travel lead, rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, solar, homebuilders) lag. Semi bifurcation deepens after Micron -16% guidance miss. Expect choppy session with upward bias in first half, OPEX-driven chaos into close. S&P 5,930 faces resistance at 6,000, support at 5,850.

sections.title: Macro
sections.content: Nov PCE 2.4% YoY (below 2.5% consensus) provides relief after hawkish Fed cut on Dec 18. Fed dot plot slashed 2025 rate cut expectations from 4 to 2. 10Y yield at 4.52%, 2-10 spread +19bps. Dollar index 107.62 retreating slightly. Higher-for-longer rates structurally negative for duration-sensitive assets (REITs, utilities, solar project finance).

sections.title: Corporate
sections.content: Micron crashed 16% on weak Q2 guidance ($7.9B vs $8.98B expected). NAND oversupply and consumer demand weakness. Airlines surging — UAL +4.5%, DAL +2.6% on strong travel demand and lower oil. GE +3% on aerospace/defense rotation. Broadcom digesting blowout AI earnings. FSLR -4.6% and ENPH -4.4% as solar crushed by rate repricing.

sections.title: Technicals
sections.content: UVXY +14% yesterday signals peak fear — contrarian bounce setup in quality names. VIX elevated but PCE print should compress it. Triple witching creates artificial volume spikes and potential mean reversion. Sector ETF flows show clear rotation: JETS +1.85%, XLU +0.48%, while XLRE -1.72%, XHB -2.19%, XLE -0.88%.

sections.title: SectorRotation
sections.content: Clear rotation into consumer discretionary travel (airlines, cruises, hotels), aerospace/industrials (GE, BA, RTX), and AI-adjacent power (VST, CCJ). Rotation OUT of rate-sensitive (REITs, homebuilders, solar), non-AI semis (MU contagion to LRCX, AMAT), and energy (oversupply narrative). Financials mixed — JPM +1.1% but KRE -0.9%.

sections.title: Catalysts
sections.content: PCE below consensus is the primary catalyst for today's bounce. Triple witching $6.6T OPEX creates mechanical flows. Government shutdown risk is headline noise with limited market impact. Micron earnings miss creates contagion risk in non-AI semiconductor names.

scenarios.trade: Airlines are the clear momentum leaders in this rotation regime. UAL +4.5% yesterday, strongest single-stock gainer ex-volatility products. PCE relief reinforces consumer travel spend narrative. Lower oil prices ($69.46 WTI) directly boost airline margins. Post-Fed rotation favors cyclicals with strong demand fundamentals over rate-sensitive sectors. Triple witching volume supports continuation of momentum names.

scenarios.implication: Triple witching creates unpredictable reversals; profit-taking after +4.5% day could cap upside

scenarios.trade: GE Aerospace is a primary beneficiary of the rotation into industrials/defense. +3% yesterday on strong sector flows. Aerospace aftermarket demand remains robust. Defense budget tailwinds persist regardless of rate environment. Less rate-sensitive than growth/tech names, making it an ideal rotation target in a higher-for-longer regime. GE Vernova spin-off narrative provides additional catalyst.

scenarios.implication: Overbought after sharp move; triple witching mechanical flows could reverse momentum

scenarios.trade: Micron crashed 16% on massive guidance miss ($7.9B vs $8.98B expected revenue, $1.43 vs $1.91 EPS). NAND oversupply, consumer demand weakness, and data center SSD demand pause cited. This is not just a miss — it's a fundamental demand revision that creates contagion across non-AI semi names (LRCX -5.3%, AMAT -2.4%). Dead cat bounce likely capped as sellers use any rally to exit. Semi sentiment destroyed.

scenarios.implication: Oversold bounce could be sharp given -16% move; short squeeze risk on triple witching day

scenarios.trade: Solar sector getting crushed by higher-for-longer rate repricing. FSLR -4.6% yesterday, ENPH -4.4%. Hawkish Fed directly negative for solar project financing costs — fewer 2025 rate cuts means higher discount rates on long-duration renewable projects. This is a structural headwind, not a one-day move. Policy uncertainty around IRA subsidies under potential Trump admin adds further risk. Solar is on the wrong side of the rotation.

scenarios.implication: PCE relief could trigger short-covering; government shutdown resolution could lift sentiment broadly

scenarios.trade: Vistra Energy is the power/nuclear play benefiting from AI data center electricity demand narrative. +3.2% yesterday, outperforming broader market significantly. Unlike solar (rate-sensitive project finance), nuclear/natural gas power generation benefits from demand growth regardless of rate environment. The AI power demand theme (data centers need baseload electricity) is structural and rate-insensitive. CCJ (uranium) +1.9% confirms the nuclear power bid.

scenarios.implication: Extended move could face profit-taking; triple witching volatility could create sharp pullback
